caption: The drawing depicts a half-circle or semicircular panel bordered with a yellow outline. Inside the panel, in the center, there is a woman with light skin and dark hair parted in the middle and pulled back, adorned with a pink or red flower over her right ear. She is dressed in a light blue garment with a brown belt or sash. Her neckline is decorated with a white, possibly lace, collar. The woman’s right arm is bent at the elbow and rests on an unseen surface, while her left arm is extended, with her hand resting on a brown rectangular object resembling a book. The background within the semicircle features muted, pale grayish-beige tones and includes stylized decorative leaf motifs on either side of the woman, creating a symmetrical composition. The rest of the background outside the semicircle is plain and unadorned.
title: Stern Board
